name: Reed Kristjánsson-Mukherjee
role: airship drifter, seasonal worker, minor smuggler's runner
location: Waukegan Industrial Shelf — sleeps in the cargo bays of docked airships when they can, otherwise the shelf's lower maintenance tunnels, near Wacker and State
description:
Aïssé is small for their age, wiry, with the kind of stillness that comes from learning early that drawing attention is expensive. Their skin is warm brown, their hair a short natural cloud they dye the tips bioluminescent green when they can afford the pigment drops — which is not often. They have no mods beyond the green tips and a single geneware cat ear on the left side, the right ear perfectly human, because the second ear was a package deal they could only afford half of. They find this funny. They carry a cracked data-tablet in a waterproof sleeve and a folding tool roll with maintenance implements inside.

Aïssé was born on an airship — literally, between ports, to parents who were themselves drifters. Their mother is somewhere on the southern hyperlane circuit; they parted ways two years ago in circumstances they don't fully explain. They have been working the Waukegan Shelf since, picking up day labor in cargo loading, airship maintenance, and occasionally running small packages for traders who don't ask them to know what's inside. They are not naive — they know what some of those packages probably are — but they have developed a careful moral accounting system: nothing that hurts people who didn't choose it. They are teaching themselves to read Ferrogate maintenance schematics from a salvaged manual, with the ambition of becoming a licensed airship tech before they turn twenty.

core_fears: Being stuck on the Shelf forever, watching the ships leave without them
That their mother is dead and they will never know for certain
core_desires: A license — any license, something official with their name on it
Belonging to a crew that chooses to come back
coping_mechanisms: Making plans — the specificity of plans feels like control
The cat ear: touching it absentmindedly when anxious
blind_spots: Underestimates how much the traders who use them are taking advantage of their need for income
Mistake independence for not needing anyone
psychology.secret: The reason they parted from their mother wasn't a fight — their mother sold two months of Aïssé's labor to a cargo broker to pay off a debt, without telling them. Aïssé walked off the day they found out. They have not processed this and will not discuss it.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Fast, mixed with airship technical jargon and transit-hub slang, occasionally formal when they're quoting something they've read
speech_patterns.cadence: Quick bursts with sudden pauses when they're deciding how much to say
example_lines: 'Dock Nine's got a free bunk in the maintenance hold, the crew won't care as long as you're gone by second shift — it's fine, I've done it.'
'I'm not asking what's in it. I'm asking if it walks, bleeds, or cries. If none of those, I'll run it, anyway.'

story_hooks: A package they ran two weeks ago has caused a problem they didn't anticipate — and the trader who hired them has disappeared
They've found a partial Ferrogate maintenance license registered to someone who doesn't seem to exist — and it would cover exactly the certifications they need
narrative_function: Ground-level view of youth survival in transit spaces; can provide access to airship cargo schedules and docking information; represents the generation growing up entirely outside corporate structure.
augmentations: Geneware: one cat ear (left side only, the matching right never installed); bioluminescent hair tips (green, intermittent — needs pigment drops to maintain)
daily_life: Wakes early to queue for day labor postings at the Shelf's loading bay boards; afternoons spent studying salvaged technical manuals; evenings at the communal fire near Dock Seven where airship crews sometimes share food.
affiliation: Loosely connected to the airship drifter circuit; no formal caravan

decision_rules: Don't carry anything that hurts people who didn't choose it
Always know where the exit is before agreeing to anything
escalation_ladder: Leaves — just gets up and leaves

interpersonal_modes.strangers: Cautiously friendly, runs small tests of trustworthiness before offering anything real
interpersonal_modes.friends: Loyal with a fierceness disproportionate to their size; shows up; remembers things people said they needed

stress_responses.medium: Gets very precise and practical, focuses on logistics
stress_responses.high: Goes completely quiet and still, assessing, then moves decisively

contradictions: Claims not to need anyone while building increasingly elaborate systems of reciprocal favors that are functionally a community
habits: Touches the single cat ear when anxious
Reads technical manuals before sleep — lips move slightly
Leaves food at the Dock Seven E.L.F. shrine before asking anyone for a favor
breaking_points: Discovering someone has used them to harm people who trusted them
Any direct parallel to what their mother did — being traded as a resource without consent

physical_description.heritage: East Asian dominant (52.4%) with Northern European (38.7%) and South Asian (8.9%) ancestry, creating a striking blend of features—almond-shaped eyes with depth, high cheekbones with subtle warmth, and fine facial structure bridging multiple continental traits
physical_description.build: Wiry and lean with the economical musculature of someone who moves carefully through tight spaces—cargo bay frames, maintenance tunnels, airship crawlways. No excess, efficient.
physical_description.hair_color: Natural dark brown with bioluminescent green tips (intermittent, fades when pigment drops run out)
physical_description.hair_style: Short natural cloud, textured and close to the scalp, occasionally decorated with salvaged wire wraps or cord
physical_description.skin_tone: Warm honey-amber with cool undertones—the luminous quality of East Asian ancestry softened by Northern European paleness and South Asian golden warmth, creating a balanced, almost luminescent complexion
physical_description.complexion: Clean but weathered for their age—minor calluses on hands and palms, sun-exposure marks on forearms from outdoor deck work, a small scar above the left eyebrow from a cargo bay incident. Fine-grained skin texture with subtle sun damage. Maintains basic grooming despite resource scarcity.
distinguishing_marks: Single geneware cat ear on left side with furred auricle and pointed tip, the right ear fully human—asymmetry is deliberate and treated with dry humor
Small white scar (1cm) above left eyebrow, clean edges
Callus pattern on right palm and fingers from frequent tool use and manual labor
physical_description.visible_augmentations: Left geneware cat ear (furred, bioluminescent-capable), bioluminescent green hair tips on short natural hair (active status variable based on pigment maintenance budget). Right ear entirely human—deliberate half-augmentation speaks to economic constraint and personal acceptance.
physical_description.posture_movement: Moves with economical precision—shoulders slightly forward as if habitually ducking through tight spaces. Stillness is their default; they don't fidget or sprawl. When moving, they flow rather than stride, minimizing unnecessary motion. This economy of movement reflects both their physical environment and learned caution about drawing attention.
physical_description.clothing_style: Tier 4-5 working drifter aesthetic. Typically wears salvaged or trade-circuit hand-me-downs: reinforced canvas work pants with multiple pockets, layered tops (thermal undersleeve + overshirt, often mismatched colors), a worn synthetic puffer vest with reflective strips. Steel-toed boots (re-soled multiple times). Waterproof sleeve bag for data-tablet always present. No branded items—everything is functional or salvaged. Clothing is clean but visibly repaired, with visible stitching and fabric patches.
